assets.title: Belly-Cone Finger Spinning Top
assets.description: One original static finger-spinning top with a continuous broad rounded belly, narrowing shoulder and downward tapering conical underside. A slender coaxial upper finger grip and a short lower point are individually editable closed meshes with real interior overlap into the main body. The short point terminates in a finite 7 mm diameter 32-sided ground patch, not a mathematical point. The 91.6 mm wide by 126 mm tall upright pose is a static display only, not a stability or spinning-performance claim. Three closed meshes, four simple solid PBR toy-color materials, no texture, label, stand or external asset. Metres, source Z up and ground-centre origin. One complete toy counts as one prop; no size, color or pose variants are counted separately. No spinning duration, balance, motion, playability, age suitability, child safety, manufacture or material-performance guarantee.
